methodology: Tracked non-test Go files, excluding generated Ent. Comments and string contents are masked for locating HTTP selector calls; original path expressions are retained. Known logging/keyword-matcher Any/Match calls are excluded. Frontend covers tracked non-test router TypeScript path declarations.
limitations: Source declarations are not fully expanded runtime routes; group prefixes, loops, aliases and feature gates still require contract and runtime verification.
A registered route can be disabled, deprecated or a placeholder; the preservation matrix records those distinctions.
Counts do not prove functional completeness or implementation acceptance. Background behavior, data rules and UI actions also require the feature matrix.

This is a whole-repository source inventory, not migration scope. Only customized business and its explicitly mapped dependencies are migration requirements; unrelated upstream functionality is excluded.
